name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. The API key was already exported in the environment. I installed the Fireworks Python SDK (`pip install --pre fireworks-ai`), created the quickstart script, and ran it. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model: the response was "¡Hola!".
deviations: The quickstart specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed". I queried the available models endpoint and used `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` instead, which successfully returned a chat completion.

env_ready.evidence: curl 8.14.1 (x86_64-pc-linux-gnu) libcurl/8.14.1 OpenSSL/3.5.5 zlib/1.3.1 brotli/1.1.0 zstd/1.5.7 libidn2/2.3.8 libpsl/0.21.2 libssh2/1.11.1 nghttp2/1.64.0 nghttp3/1.8.0 librtmp/2.3 OpenLDAP/2.6.10

friction.detail: The quickstart specifies a model that is not available, causing the first API call to fail immediately with a NOT_FOUND error.
After the first failure, trying other common model names (llama-v3p1-70b, llama-v3p1-8b, llama-v3-70b) all return the same NOT_FOUND error, forcing guesswork.
The developer must manually call the /v1/models endpoint to find a valid model ID because the quickstart examples are outdated.
